text:
Marta (PM): quick accessibility pass on the rollout flyout — I noticed the focus gets trapped when you open "Canary groups" and then tab past the last toggle.

Emma (Design): repro'd it on mac + VoiceOver and Windows + NVDA. focus lands on the overlay background after the last checkbox.

Kyle (Eng): hm that sounds like our overlay is not setting focus back to the close button. I think we call `overlay.focus()` but maybe a focusable element got removed by the transition.

Roberta (Accessibility): low friction fixes: 1) ensure the close button is programmatically focusable on open 2) set `aria-modal="true"` and add `inert` or `aria-hidden="true"` on the background container while flyout is open 3) implement roving tabindex for the group toggles so Tab order is predictable for keyboard users.

Emma (Design): also the canary status pill uses #6D28D9 on white — appears fine on my screen but contrast check (4.5:1) fails for the small 12px label. Can we bold it or increase bg contrast?

Kyle (Eng): quick note — the toggles are native checkboxes visually hidden and styled; roving tabindex might be heavier than needed if native focus works. Could be the CSS `pointer-events: none` on the wrapper during animation that removes focusable behavior. I'll check.

ax-bot: axe scan summary: 3 violations found — 
- "Focus order" on `div[role="dialog"]` (tab stops to non-interactive)
- "Color contrast" on `.pill--canary` (AA for normal text FAIL)
- "ARIA allowed attr" on `.rollout-toggle` (aria-* on non-widget)

Roberta (Accessibility): for the aria-* issue, we often accidentally put `aria-checked` on a decorative span. Keep ARIA on the input element. Also avoid `role="button"` on custom elements unless you handle keyboard enter/space.

Marta (PM): actionables?

Emma (Design): design changes — increase canary pill bg to #5B21B6 or use white text bold 600, and make close icon 24px and ensure visible focus ring. I'll drop a tiny spec in Figma.

Kyle (Eng): engineering fixes — I'll: 
1) remove pointer-events toggle during animation or keep it but toggle focusable children explicitly,
2) move aria attributes to native inputs,
3) add `aria-modal` + `aria-hidden` toggles,
4) add keyboard handler for Escape to close.

Roberta (Accessibility): test plan:
- NVDA/VoiceOver walkthrough of opening flyout, tabbing forward/backwards, interacting with each canary checkbox, closing with Esc, and verifying screen reader annoucements for expanded/collapsed state.
- Run automated axe on staging after change.

Marta (PM): timeline? this is small but affects rollout UX for a customer pilot next week.

Kyle (Eng): I can push a patch tomorrow morning and put it behind a feature flag.

Emma (Design): will update Figma tonight, add notes about focus styles (2px outline with `focus-visible` only) and the stronger pill color.

Roberta (Accessibility): I'll pair with QA on the manual pass after Kyle's patch.

Marta (PM): thanks everyone :thumbsup: — ping me when PR is up and I'll schedule a quick smoke with the pilot team.

Kyle (Eng): putting the branch up now: `github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4823` — linked to issue #1204.

ax-bot: quick re-scan on PR — Color contrast fixed on `.pill--canary` ; one remaining: focus order on dialog still flagged.

Emma (Design): ok noted. maybe the focus trap helper needs to set focus to close after transition end. I'll add a note in the thread. :eyes: 

Roberta (Accessibility): final nit — screen readers read the group heading twice because we use `<h4>` inside a labelled region. Consider `aria-label` on the group container instead of repeating visible heading for SR.

Marta (PM): great catch. Thanks team — followups: Emma (Figma spec), Kyle (PR + fix focus order), Roberta (test doc).

Kyle (Eng): PR updated with `focus()` on close after transition end + inert background. Requesting review.

ax-bot: re-run results: no critical violations. Remaining: 1 contrast ratio borderline on small text in secondary action (deferred).

Roberta (Accessibility): passing enough for pilot. We should still track the secondary action contrast in a follow-up ticket.

Marta (PM): filing follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/UX-2112 — thanks all! :party:
